rows.notes: F1 (Appendix R6-8): teamfights per game = count of distinct fight_id values on fight_call events (§9.1 L1 Fight Call; 3+ / escalated fights emit a call; 1v1 do not).

F2 (Appendix R6-8): combo chains = maximal sets of ability hits (skill_id present and ≠ "auto") on one target where consecutive lands are ≤ 1.5s apart, first→last ≤ 1.5s, and ≥2 distinct allied sources appear. Autos excluded.

F3 (Appendix R6-8): clutch moments = (a) low-HP survives — a hit leaves hp_after/max_hp < 0.15 and that unit has no death within the next 2s (max_hp via statsAtLevel); plus (b) down-a-champ wins — a takedown_score whose scoring team has ≤4 living members at that instant.
F4 (Appendix R6-8): close finish = 1 if final |score_blue − score_red| ∈ {1, 2}, else 0.
Companion to F4 (reported): reconstruct score from takedown_score / zone_tick / claim_award; each change of sign(score_blue − score_red) among {−1,0,+1} counts one lead change.

Contested-pit share (Appendix R6-8 companion): fraction of fight_call events whose centroid lies within ZONE_RADIUS of ZONE_CENTER (pit-centred Fight Calls / all Fight Calls). Lab derivation from the event log; not a sim export.
